title: A uniform bound for the minimal degree of an isogeny between principally polarized superspecial abelian surfaces
summary: Let $p>3$ be a prime number. If $A$ and $B$ are two principally polarized superspecial abelian surfaces over $\mathbb{F}_{p^{2}}$ with $p^{2}$-Frobenius $[-p]$, we prove that there exists a separable polarized isogeny between them with multiplier at most $p/\sqrt{2}$. The multiplier bound is uniform in the pair and asymptotically optimal up to a small multiplicative constant. Given quaternionic coordinates, we provide a deterministic algorithm that satisfies this upper bound in polynomial time.
